_comment: Golden set over eval/corpus.json. 'retrieval' cases drive precision@k / recall@k / MRR; 'relevant' lists the corpus link(s) a correct retrieval must surface. Queries mix English and Traditional Chinese on purpose — the embedding model is English-centric while the corpus is zh-TW, and the per-language split in the eval report is the evidence for (or against) swapping to a multilingual model. 'judge' cases drive the LLM-as-judge relevancy eval of /ask answers.
